rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for striking something with the foot, including kicking a ball; add a directional complement when its destination matters.

example.english: I kick the ball into the goal.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 goek3 tek3 go3 bo1 jap6 lung4 mun4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for one kick as a physical blow or strike.

example.english: They gave me a kick.鏡頭要影晒成個舞台。

rows.note: Use this for the action or movement of swinging and raising the leg, especially in dance or exercise.

example.english: We need to do more kick exercises during warm-up.

rows.note: Use this for giving up a habit or addiction, especially smoking or another repeated behaviour.

example.english: I finally kick my smoking habit.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 gaai3 diu6 jin1 jan5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the pleasure or amusement someone gets from something rather than for a physical kick.

example.english: The biggest kick I get from gaming is playing with friends.

rows.note: Use this when someone is summarily ejected from a place, group, or organization rather than physically kicked.

example.english: They kick him out of the company for always being late.
example.traditional: 佢成日遲到，公司最後踢走咗佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 gung1 si1 zeoi3 hau6 tek3 zau2 zo2 keoi5
